items: A flame the size of a match head sits on your thumb whenever you want it. It lights candles, pipes and stubborn stoves, and it goes out in a stiff breeze.
curses: There is always a small stone in your left shoe. Take it out and there is another one by the end of the street. Going barefoot moves the stone to wherever you are about to step.
Walk a hundred miles without once stopping to take it out.
